title: Largest number
prompt: Return the largest number in the array with a loop, not max(). The array always has at least one number.

tests.name: -1 is the largest of all negatives

hints: Start with the first item as the biggest so far.
`var biggest = nums[0]`, then `for n in nums:` with `if n > biggest:` update.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.
